data.body: HANDOFF STATE 2026-11-11 (PST): CLOSED (class preexisting) through the completion gate. Fix merged as Gerrit 3357 at `614175831f6`, stacked on 3356. Before each explicit maintenance step, `run_auto_maintenance` removes a `<common-dir>/objects/maintenance.lock` older than 12 h (git's own gc.pid staleness rule) using the shared revalidating `git_locking._reclaim_if_stale`, and logs a warning when it does. The lock literal's mechanism marker names the sunset task `sulfuric-zebraic-hackee` (open, P4): retire the reclaim once git expires the lock itself or maintenance moves out of the write path. Production: the next write after deploy self-heals any stale lock older than 12 h. No operator action is needed.
